The words of a failure hook, a case for each: a text written with the word any
old way, that text as it is laid out, the word written wrongly, and where
and why the reader refuses that. `WRITE_WORDS=1` on the test that reads
this writes what is laid out and what is refused, to be read before it is
kept.

=== failure_hook.do
--- written
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: fail
        on_fail:
            - do: noop
--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a:
    do: fail
    on_fail:
      - do: noop
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: fail
        on_fail:
            - do: nothing.like.it
--- refused 6:15
there is no action called `nothing.like.it`

=== failure_hook.emit
--- written
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: fail
        on_fail:
            - emit: {topic: w.failed}
--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a:
    do: fail
    on_fail:
      - emit: { topic: w.failed }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: fail
        on_fail:
            - emit: 3
--- refused 6:15
`emit` needs `topic` (where to publish, e.g. `build.slow`)

=== failure_hook.when
--- written
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: fail
        on_fail:
            - do: noop
              when: ${ 1 == 1 }
--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a:
    do: fail
    on_fail:
      - do: noop
        when: ${ 1 == 1 }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: fail
        on_fail:
            - do: noop
              when: ${ 1 + }
--- refused 7:21
`when`: the expression ends too soon

=== failure_hook.with
--- written
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: fail
        on_fail:
            - do: log
              with: {message: hi}
--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a:
    do: fail
    on_fail:
      - do: log
        with: { message: hi }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: fail
        on_fail:
            - do: noop
              with: [a]
--- refused 7:21
`with` must be a mapping, found a list
